_comment: compaction_handoff (design log/compaction_handoff_design_v0.4.md in the KairosChain repository; the mod in mod/ drives the cycle, these hooks are its insurance).
UserPromptSubmit asks the agent for an L2 handoff from the request point on; PreCompact writes a
fallback record (no conversation text) and holds off one auto-compaction per cycle when no fresh
handoff exists; SessionStart (matcher compact) always tells the compacted session what to read.
The projector merges this into the host settings under a _projected_by tag; nobody edits
settings.json by hand. Projection makes these hooks act on every Claude Code session of the project.
Only PreCompact ever exits 2, and only for trigger auto, once per cycle; every other failure is
non-blocking (exit 1, cause on stderr). after_compact.rb always exits 0 with its notice.
